title: The Qliphoth
subtitle: The Tree of Death
text: In the old Kabbalistic tradition, the Sephiroth form the Tree of Life. The Qliphoth are their inverse: the Tree of Death, the shells. Here they are complementary forces, not good against evil. Fungi consume the dead and return them to the cycle. The Qliphoth Tree occupies that other side. The Bloom of the Qliphoth rite establishes a living Bloom, its owner, and its nine-pome lifecycle. Placing a Bloom block alone does not establish that bond or begin Communion. The rite matters because it makes the tree part of your blood-memory, not because a divine power forbids planting it.
